### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

The Principal Product Manager (Marketing) exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning to accelerate global growth. In this high\-impact role, you will lead the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models while enabling our global sales team with the tools, positioning, and competitive insights they need to win. * **Author** and deliver high\-impact enablement assets (such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts) for the global sales team.


* **Partner** with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI\-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.

* **Build and maintain** strong cross\-functional relationships across the sales, product, and go\-to\-market (GTM) motions to ensure unified messaging.


* **Represent** JumpCloud as a speaker and thought leader at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.

* **Tools or systems knowledge:**


	+ Modern AI productivity tools and workflow automation platforms

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager for Revenue Cycle Management
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

Technical Product Manager \- RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) Common Data Platform

  

The Technical Product Manager (TPM) \- RCM Common Data Platform drives the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of building out a unified data platform across the full Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) lifecycle. The solution will ultimately ingest disparate EHR and healthcare data sources, standardize them and normalize them into single source of truth. This individual will work alongside members from across Optum to solve complex business needs for our internal operations teams. The role is key to execution on critical use cases to understand the data, ingest data, unify disparate data and drive AI powered insights. The ideal candidate for this role must be passionate about how we can leverage data to drive improvements in our RCM Operations, effective at working in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment and confident in their interactions with senior leaders. The TPM RCM Common Data Platform role combines deep technical product expertise with solid RCM data knowledge to deliver scalable, compliant, AI powered insights that reduce administrative burden, improves performance, accelerates throughput, and strengthen financial outcomes.

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-253197 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Aug. 26, 2026 CATEGORY: Value and Access
ABOUT AMGEN


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.


ABOUT THE ROLE


Role Description:


In the face of a US health care system growing more complex day\-by\-day, we must constantly adapt and evolve our strategies to ensure our patients have appropriate access to our medicines. The US Value \& Access (V\&A) Insights Manager will play a critical role in monitoring, diagnosing, and addressing payer obstacles and challenges.


The Value and Access Manager is responsible for analytics relating to managed care/organized customers and help shape payer \& copay strategies for Value \& Access Analytics insights organization . The Role will be part of a cross functional analytics insights team to provide integrated analyses and insights to US Market access and Patient access and reimbursement team. This role is specifically responsible for providing insights impacting payer reimbursement strategies through secondary data analytics and data integration


This position will report to the Senior Manager, Value \& Access Insights team

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the analytics for US Value \& Access rare disease Business unit
* Partner with US Coverage and Pricing, Contracting, Patient access \& Reimbursement and other Commercial teams to build and prioritize analytics and insights plans in support of value and access strategy for Amgen brands
* Provide in\-depth, expertise\-based oversight and delivery of managed markets analysis including product formulary position, utilization management controls, customer segmentation and control/sophistication assessment.
* Develop frameworks \& analytics to characterize the Rare Disease patient journey, including symptoms/diagnosis, referral pathways, treatment initiation, switching, discontinuation, and persistence Prepare, continuously refine and present periodic reports tracking product and portfolio performance against business objectives.
* Execute analytics plan to support payer insights from various payer datasets based on detailed understanding of related datasets i.e Patient level claims data; Payer claims data; Formulary coverage; Specialty Pharmacy Data.
* Oversee efforts of 1\-3 associates, including setting performance standards, managing their staffing, and monitoring performance
* Build and maintain strong relationships with cross functional partners; proactively seeks buy\-in and provide ongoing support to address business needs
* Lead the development of analytics models to generate strategic actionable business insights using SQL, Python and Microsoft Excel

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 5 years of Information Systems experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, statistics or STEM majors with a minimum of 7 years of Information Systems experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with new product / indication launch especially in rare disease areas
* Prior working experience on Analytics of products with medical benefit and Pharmacy benefit usage
* Prior experience in contracts and pricing, direct payer experience or value marketing and have a good foundational understanding of the US payer environment and a strong foundation in the U.S. healthcare market
* Excellent conceptual problem\-solving skills with demonstrated ability to bring structure to vaguely defined problems, pragmatic problem\-solving approach, and manage execution
* Exceptional written/oral communication skills and executive presence across functions and across different levels of leadership
* Strong leadership skills with a demonstrated ability to influence different styles
* 5\+ years of healthcare experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, health care, and/or strategy consulting with specific experience and expertise in coverage, access and reimbursement drivers impacting the biopharmaceutical industry
* High degree of analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Exhibits strong understanding of business strategies
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience with Databricks platform for data analytics
* Proficiency in any one of the languages \- R, Python, SAS


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.


We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

* Analyze ServiceNow incident, request, change, catalog task, approval, SLA, and closure data to identify operational bottlenecks, recurring handoff delays, aging queues, rework loops, and ownership ambiguity across SaaS Operations teams.

This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

 As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Materials Product Manager leads the development and management of a portfolio of Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Analytical Reference Materials, and Certified Reference Materials.  As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. jobs.description:
Position Description  

JD Title : Lead Analyst\-GPP  

Company Profile:  

We’re Hiring at CGI for our GCC \- Right Here in Hyderabad!  

Join us at the intersection of technology, finance, and innovation. You will be working to support the Financial Services Group, one of the top\-tier financial institutions in the U.S. You’ll help shape digital solutions for a global enterprise—from the ground up.  

This is more than a job. It’s your opportunity to:  

* Work on cutting\-edge technologies
* Collaborate with global teams
* Build a career with purpose and impact


Ready to build the future of banking? Let’s talk.  

  

We are looking for Global PAYplus (GPP) Consultant with strong experience in Finastra Global PAYplus implementation and support. The candidate should have expertise in payments processing, SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, message flows, system configuration, and production support within the banking/payments domain. Experience in integration, troubleshooting, and end\-to\-end payment lifecycle management is essential, along with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

Key Responsibilities  

Implement, configure, and support Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP) solutions for domestic and cross\-border payment processing.  

Configure and customize payment workflows, message routing, business rules, validation rules, and payment processing components within GPP.  

Support end\-to\-end payment processing across various payment types, including SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, SEPA, RTGS, ACH, and High\-Value Payments.  

Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical configurations within the GPP platform.  

Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide timely resolution for payment processing incidents.  

Support application deployments, upgrades, patch implementations, and environment management activities.  

Collaborate with infrastructure, middleware, database, and integration teams to ensure seamless application availability.  

Develop and execute functional, integration, and regression test cases during implementation and release cycles.  

Monitor payment processing, system performance, and application health while ensuring adherence to SLA commitments.  

Participate in release planning, production deployments, disaster recovery exercises, and post\-release validation.  

Prepare technical documentation, operational runbooks, configuration guides, and knowledge transfer documents.  

Ensure compliance with banking regulations, security standards, and payment industry best practices.  

  

Required Skills  

6\-8years of experience in Banking and Payments, with strong hands\-on expertise in Finastra Global PAYplus (GPP).  

Experience in GPP implementation, production support, system configuration, and payment processing.  

Strong understanding of domestic and international payment processing and payment lifecycle management.  

Expertise in SWIFT MT, SWIFT MX, and ISO 20022 messaging standards.  

Knowledge of payment systems such as SEPA, ACH, RTGS, Wire Payments, and cross\-border payment processing.  

Experience in configuring payment workflows, message routing, queues, and business rules within GPP.  

Strong understanding of payment message formats, validations, reconciliation, and exception handling.  

Experience integrating GPP with upstream and downstream banking applications through APIs, MQ, file\-based integrations, or middleware.  

Hands\-on experience in application support, production incident management, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.  

Good knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as Oracle or SQL Server.  

Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and basic scripting is an added advantage.  

Experience with ITIL processes, incident, problem, and change management.  

  

Preferred Skills  

Experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, or enterprise integration technologies.  

Knowledge of IBM MQ, Kafka, or other messaging platforms.  

Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and DevOps practices.  

Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics.  

Understanding of payment regulations, AML, sanctions screening, and compliance frameworks.  

Finastra Global PAYplus implementation or product certification is an added advantage.**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.
  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

  

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Write and test product or system development code.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
* Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
* Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. * Own backlog strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across AI platform capabilities, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt, and operational excellence investments.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex environments involving distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, AI\-powered services, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.
* Proven experience managing backlogs that include feature delivery, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability engineering work.

We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.

The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. The Data Analyst II shows high attention to detail to ensure that data updates they conduct, as well as data transfers they output and deliver to our clients are of the utmost quality.

**Essential:**  

* 2\-4 years of experience working in a data\-driven environment.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), as well as Microsoft Windows 2000/2003/XP/7 and the suite of Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with standard data mining and data presentation techniques.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines \& multi\-task in a fast\-paced work environment.
* Demonstrate extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
* Must have very strong skills with Microsoft Office applications.
* Must be comfortable working with business users and technical teams.


**Desirable:**  

* Must have excellent written communication skills, including the ability to effectively document procedures, processes and results.
* Must have excellent verbal communication skills, as interaction with team members occurs daily.
* Ability to create and execute SQL Queries is required.
* Familiarity with C\# programming language is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Visual Basic is a plus.
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 is a plus.

 Our Company

FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.

 Experience working with international/US/UK clients
 



 Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles

 Prior experience in a software development company
 



  





  





 With Regards,
 



  





 Nemani Namrata

jobs.description:
**About us**  

Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers.

 **Supply Chain and Logistics**  

Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision\-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk\-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyze both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem\-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.

 **Network Planning and Global Intelligence**  

A role in Network Planning and Global Intelligence means creating industry leading intelligence solutions to drive best in class omni\-channel guest experiences at the lowest cost to Target. You might focus on enabling the future transportation operating model, optimizing inventory management, driving topology planning or leveraging deep business insights and analytics to propel Target’s Supply Chain. As a network steward, we create forecasts, design inventory optimization strategies and leverage technology to ensure our inventory is available at the right time, in the right places and quantity to meet the needs of our guest, stores and operational goals. Super\-powered first and foremost by our people, and supported by robust process and technology, we are a team of data\-focused, curious minds who love to solve hard problems to enable a dynamic, fast paced Supply Chain Network.

 **About the Job:**  

As a Sr. Product Manager in transportation, you’ll be responsible for creating capabilities to improve the speed, visibility, accuracy, and precision of Target’s supply chain. You will define and facilitate implementation of new technology solutions to onboard and integrate with transportation carriers supporting the movement of goods across all miles and all modes of transportation.  

The desired candidate would have a strong background in supply chain, transportation operations, carrier integration patterns such as Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), experience with load tracking systems, as well as familiarity with supply chain systems interoperability across a broad ecosystem (vendor, purchasing, WMS, TMS, EDI, freight payment, etc).  

Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.  

As a Sr. Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will lead the development of a comprehensive product strategy and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product domain. You will need to leverage extensive knowledge of your product, as well as, customer feedback, key data and analytics, and other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product.  

You will be the “voice of the product” to all outside stakeholders advocating for your product and ensuring their needs are met and that the product team is getting the leadership and support that it needs to be successful. You will need to cultivate strong relationships across the enterprise in order to drive collaboration and alignment with key partners and stakeholders across pyramids.  

You will develop and actively maintain a product roadmap outlining prioritization for the customer themes, technical needs, and design challenges to be delivered and you will be accountable to make final decisions on scope and prioritization relative to the product backlog. You will be accountable to create and manage product objectives and key results, key metrics for your product, as well as related P\&L impacts.  

You will oversee progress against product backlogs to ensure work and priorities are in line with the product strategy while prioritizing themes, epics, and stories, to ensure work focuses on those with maximum value that are aligned with the product strategy. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  

**About you:**

* 4\-year college degree (or equivalent experience)
* 8\+ years of retail, transportation, product management, or equivalent domain experience
* Experience with technology and ability to facilitate communication between business and technology teams
* Strong communication skills with proven ability to influence peers, key stakeholders and leaders
* Expert at working in an agile environment (e.g. user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)
* Strategic mindset and bias for action with strong ability for strategic planning, defining ORKs and driving business outcomes

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Task Intelligence and Agentic Automation
jobs.description:
**About Us**


Working at Target means helping millions of guests discover the joy of everyday life. Behind every guest experience is a complex ecosystem of team members, workflows, applications, and business processes that power our operations.


As we accelerate our enterprise AI and automation strategy, we are investing in intelligent platforms that help teams work smarter, automate repetitive work, and continuously improve how work gets done.

**Team overview:**

The **Automation Platform team** is building the next generation of AI\-powered capabilities that transform enterprise productivity. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to define and scale Target's Task Intelligence platform—the foundation for automation discovery, workflow optimization, and agentic automation.

**Role overview:**

As the **Sr Product Manager for Task Intelligence and Agentic Automation**, you will own the product vision, strategy, discovery, and execution for a platform that understands how work happens across Target.


By analyzing digital work signals across applications, systems, and workflows, the platform generates actionable intelligence that helps individuals work more effectively, teams operate more consistently, and business leaders identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.


Your mission is to transform digital work signals into actionable intelligence that powers automation, workflow optimization, and agentic experiences. By understanding how work gets done across Target, you will help teams improve productivity, scale automation, and build the foundation for future AI\-driven ways of working.

**Strategic Context**


This role fits within a team working on the intersection of four strategic outcomes:

* **Task Intelligence** – Understanding how work gets done.
* **Automation** – Identifying and improving repetitive work.
* **Agentic AI** – Assisting, orchestrating, and executing work.
* **Intelligent Enterprise** – Enabling a continuously learning and improving organization using decision and process intelligence along with other capabilities.

**What You'll Do**

**Define Product Vision and Strategy**

* Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Target's Task Intelligence platform.
* Build Task Intelligence as the foundational intelligence layer that powers automation discovery, workflow optimization, process insights, and future agentic AI capabilities.
* Drive roadmap investments that advance enterprise productivity, operational excellence, and automation outcomes.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, technology, and operations to identify and prioritize high\-impact opportunities.

**Build Task Intelligence Capabilities**

* Develop capabilities that transform digital work signals into actionable intelligence about how work is performed.
* Create a unified understanding of tasks, workflows, user interactions, and execution patterns across the enterprise.
* Establish task\-level benchmarks that identify best practices, performance opportunities, and workflow friction.
* Surface insights that reduce rework, improve productivity, and enable continuous improvement.
* Partner with data science and engineering teams to create scalable intelligence models and insights.

**Deliver Automation Experiences**

* Identify repetitive, manual, and automatable work patterns.
* Partner with AI, engineering, and data science teams to build recommendation engines and automation discovery capabilities.
* Enable users and teams to discover, prioritize, and adopt automation opportunities.
* Measure automation impact and continuously improve recommendation quality and business outcomes.

**Enable Agentic Automation**

* Define product capabilities that allow Task Intelligence insights to power agentic experiences.
* Partner with AI, engineering, and automation teams to deliver experiences that assist, recommend, orchestrate, and automate work.
* Create a roadmap that evolves from workflow visibility and automation recommendations to semi\-autonomous and autonomous workflows.
* Deliver foundational capabilities that enable future AI agents to understand work patterns, business context, and execution behaviors.

**About Us:**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.


Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about TII**


At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Pyramid Overview**


A role with Target Data Science \& Engineering means the chance to help develop and manage state of the art predictive algorithms that use data at scale to automate and optimize decisions at scale. Whether you join our Statistics, Optimization or Machine Learning teams, you’ll be challenged to harness Target’s impressive data breadth to build the algorithms that power solutions our partners in Marketing, Supply Chain Optimization, Network Security and Personalization rely on.

**Team Overview**


Our Search Team powers digital search experiences for millions of Target guests and supports search capabilities used by store team members. Search plays a critical role in Target’s e\-commerce and in\-store experiences by connecting guests and team members with relevant, accurate, and timely results.


The team brings together expertise across **Data Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and MLOps** to build and operate end\-to\-end search solutions at scale. We work on areas such as SLP experience, relevance and ranking, search APIs, data pipelines, machine learning models, experimentation, and production ML infrastructure.


Our focus is on continuously improving search quality, performance, reliability, and personalization while building scalable platforms that can support Target’s evolving digital and store experiences.

**Position Overview**


As a **Search Engineer at Target**, you will help build and evolve the search and discovery experiences that enable guests to quickly find the products they need across Target’s digital platforms.


You will work on large\-scale search systems spanning **information retrieval, query understanding, relevance ranking, semantic search, machine learning, and search infrastructure**. You’ll partner closely with product managers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and other engineering teams to improve search quality while building highly scalable, reliable, and performant services.


The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals, machine learning, data engineering and MLOps with a deep interest in **search, relevance, ranking, and large\-scale distributed systems**.


You help develop and gain insight in the application architecture. You can distill an abstract architecture into concrete design and influence the implementation. You show expertise in applying the appropriate software engineering patterns to build robust and scalable systems. You are an expert in programming and apply your skills in developing the product. You have the skills to design and implement the architecture on your own, but choose to influence your fellow engineers by proposing software designs, providing feedback on software designs and/or implementation. You leverage data science in solving complex business problems. You make decisions based on data. You show good problem solving skills and can help the team in triaging operational issues. You leverage your expertise in eliminating repeat occurrences.

**About You**


We are looking to hire Engineers with prior experience on **Search** with interest in **data science, data engineering and MLOps** **:**

* Code using primarily in **Kotlin, Micronaut**.
* Experience with **Search Engines** like **SOLR** and **Elastic Search**
* Experience on streaming systems like **Kakfa.** Experience on **Kafka Streams** is added advantage.

Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.


Our office is in Bengaluru, but we offer flexibility for eligible candidates to work remotely across India. Whatever your preference \- working from home, an office, or in between \- you can choose the place that's best for your work and your lifestyle.


Atlassian is looking for a Principal Frontend Software Engineer to design, build, evolve and maintain our web frontend systems and tools in order to deliver great experiences to our users.

**Your future team**


To become a 100\-year company, we need a world\-class engineering organisation made up of empowered teams who have the tools and infrastructure to do the best work of their careers.


As part of a unified R\&D team, Engineering is prioritising key initiatives which support our customers in moving to cloud while simultaneously continuing to bring the most value to our customers through investments across our core product suite – including Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Bitbucket.


We're looking for people who want to write the future and who believe that we can accomplish so much more together.


You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager or Head of Engineering.


Responsibilities:
**In this role, you will:**

* Build high\-performing client code that is fast, testable, scalable, and high quality
* Plan, design, build, and implement scalable user interface systems that delight users
* Collaborate closely with other engineers, designers and managers to understand user pain points and iterate on great solutions
* Lead code reviews and documentation, and take on complex bug fixes
* Drive the success of projects, from the technical design, implementation, and launch to operation
* Onboard and mentor other engineers


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:
**Your background:**

* 8\+ years experience with Javascript (ES6\), HTML5, CSS and experience with modern Javascript frameworks (e.g., React, AngularJS, Vue)
* Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience)
* Understanding of modern frontend ecosystem, including but not limited to bundling, linting, testing and releasing
* Extensive experience with modern testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Cypress, Mocha, Chai)
* Strong comfortability with the JavaScript language and ecosystem
* Experience building frontend applications at scale
* Experience in Agile software development methodologies
* You strive to write code that lasts for years, not months
* Experience engineering software systems of medium\-to\-large scope and complexity
* Experience mentoring more junior engineers

**Benefits \& Perks**


Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

**About Atlassian**


At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.


We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**About the Role**


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do meaningful work that makes a positive global impact. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. With industry\-leading R\&D investment, we empower our teams to solve complex scientific challenges—from environmental protection to advancing healthcare and cancer research.


As a **Software Engineer, AI Solutions \& Platforms,** you will play a hands\-on technical role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise\-grade AI and Generative AI solutions. You will build production\-ready AI services, integrating AI models, including Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and agentic workflows into internal and external customer\-facing systems. You will also contribute to system design and development using modern AI frameworks, backend technologies, and cloud platforms. In this role, you will write high\-quality production code, collaborate closely with product owners, business stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to translate requirements into reliable technical solutions. You will develop reusable components, services, and AI solutions that are scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade Generative AI, including RAG based solutions and agentic workflows.
* Build and maintain Python based microservices and APIs.
* Contribute hands\-on to system design, including APIs, service architecture, data models, workflows, and integrations with existing backend and scientific applications.
* Integrate LLMs using Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI\-compatible APIs.
* Design and develop secure, scalable RESTful APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, reliability, authentication, rate limiting, and observability.
* Develop and optimize data pipelines using Pandas and NumPy, and implement vector\-search solutions using PostgreSQL/pgvector and Qdrant.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including R\&D, engineering, data science, IT, Q\&A, and regulatory, to define requirements, specifications, and development objectives.
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other engineers to translate requirements into reliable solutions, and deliver against agile/scrum commitments.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested production code, and help troubleshoot, optimize systems as they move into production.
* Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

**Candidate Requirement:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field. Master’s degree preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience in software engineering and developing AI solutions.
* Strong experience building backend systems with Python and REST APIs. FastAPI experience preferred.
* Experience working in agile/scrum development environments.
* Proficiency with Git\-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing strategies.
* Familiarity with building ETL/data pipelines, and data processing workflows using tools such as Pandas and NumPy.
* Experience integrating LLMs using Azure OpenAI or Anthropic Claude, or OpenAI\-compatible APIs.
* Experience integrating or building retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Nice\-to\-Have: Familiarity with MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow), ML Frameworks (scikit\-learn, PyTorch), and model evaluation frameworks.
* Nice\-to\-Have: Experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

jobs.title: Senior Software Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Frontend Engineer \- Reuters**
------------------------------------------------

Reuters is the world’s largest multimedia news provider, reaching billions of people every day and employing over 2,700 journalists in nearly 200 locations. Consumers, the media, and financial markets trust us to provide real\-time text, images, and video news across every content category.


Reuters.com and related mobile apps are consumer\-facing product platforms that enable our target customers to access all the content they need from a single destination. We are investing in our next generation of Reuters.com to make content discovery quicker and easier, improve client curation, and enable our targeted audience to consume more relevant stories (to their areas of interest) faster than ever before. We’re looking for colleagues who relish the nimbleness, creativity, and entrepreneurship required by our multimedia products. This position is based in our Bangalore, India, office, and you’ll work as part of a productive team with fun, friendly, and skilled co\-workers.


**Role Summary**

The Client Application Technology team is dedicated to creating compelling experiences that deliver Reuters' outstanding journalism to the world’s most informed professionals. The team aims to increase discovery, optimise conversion, and drive engagement across Thomson Reuters products and services. The technology focuses on web development and substantial backend service integration.


You will work with a distributed team of software developers, quality engineers, and product managers focused on developing and integrating platforms and services that power Reuters experiences, including content creation, curation, publishing, distribution, and e\-commerce.


As a Senior technologist, you will develop business\-critical applications and services for the Reuters news organisation. We provide publishers and broadcasters with news text, graphics, photos, audio, and video over the Internet and via satellite, while also offering web\-scale hosted content solutions to digital publishers.


Location: Bangalore, India, Hybrid


**Major Responsibilities**

We seek a talented Senior Front\-End Engineer to join a small, high\-performing team. You will primarily work on web\-based applications, helping architects and builders build them modular, scalable, and performant, while mentoring your peers to do the same.


We are a supportive, close\-knit team following Agile Scrum methodologies. We use modern standard and boutique technologies like JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Clojure(Script), Playwright, Docker, and AWS. The ideal candidate is an exceptional JavaScript/TypeScript developer with deep web development experience, well\-formed opinions, an obsession with appropriate abstractions and reuse, and is just as capable of defining the application's data model as they are of building the UI views. Crucially, they know how to strike a balance between pragmatism and perfection.


**About the Role:**

DevSecOps Governance

Partner with client security teams on threat modeling and audit response.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Model APIs
jobs.description:
**About Sarvam**
 Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full\-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Product Manager for Model APIs. This is the person who owns how developers and enterprises consume Sarvam's models, and who carries what they learn back into what we train next.
   

  

 You will sit at the seam between research and the market. On one side, you own the API surface: what we ship, how it is shaped, how it is priced and packaged, and whether it holds up in production. On the other, you help set model direction: which capabilities to prioritize, which languages and domains to invest in, what “good enough to ship” means, and where the next release should aim. This is a role for someone who wants to influence the model roadmap itself, not just wrap it in an interface.
   

  

****What You'll Do****
* Own the product surface for Sarvam's model APIs across speech, language, and multimodal, from spec and versioning to documentation, developer experience, and deprecation.
* Shape model roadmaps alongside research leads, bringing evidence from usage, evals, and customer signal into decisions about what gets trained, fine\-tuned, and released.
* Define what quality means for each model line and hold the bar: accuracy, latency, cost per call, robustness, and the failure modes that matter to real deployments.
* Own evaluation as a product, including benchmark suites, offline and online tests, human evals, and the reporting that makes model progress legible to everyone from researchers to customers.
* Turn customer and developer feedback into concrete model and API requirements, and close the loop by telling them what changed and why.
* Partner with infra and platform teams on rollout, capacity, monitoring, and reliability for models in production.
* Drive release planning end to end: positioning, launch, migration paths for existing users, and the trade\-off calls that come with each.
* Communicate priorities and trade\-offs clearly across research, engineering, GTM, and leadership.


****What We're Looking For****
* 3\+ years building AI/ML products, developer platforms, or APIs, ideally where the underlying model was part of the product decision rather than a fixed input.
* Working fluency with the model lifecycle: data, training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. You do not need to train models, but you should be able to hold your own in a conversation with the people who do.
* Strong analytical instincts and genuine comfort with data. You reach for the numbers before the narrative.
* Sound judgment on trade\-offs between quality, latency, and cost, and the confidence to make a call and defend it.
* Ability to work closely with researchers and earn their trust.


****Bonus Points****
* Experience with speech (ASR, TTS) or LLM APIs, and the metrics that govern them: WER, CER, MOS, TTFT, tokens per second.
* Track record shipping and maintaining a public or enterprise\-facing API.
* Hands\-on with SQL, Python, or ML tooling, enough to run your own analysis.
* Exposure to Indian language AI, multilingual systems, or evaluation for low\-resource languages.


****Why Sarvam?****
 Sarvam is a fast\-moving, high talent\-density team building full\-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population\-scale impact.
   

  

* Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar
* High ownership and high impact, from day one
* Everything we do is AI\-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems
* You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates


 If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity
===============


Nutanix is disrupting the multi\-billion dollar cloud infrastructure market by pioneering the first hybrid cloud platform that can incrementally scale out to manage petabytes of data while running tens of thousands of virtual machines.
You will work in the Nutanix Content Management team that is building a new hybrid cloud infrastructure management plane for management of core infrastructure building blocks like virtual machine templates, virtual disks and virtual appliances. We are looking for engineers with a rare and unique blend of technical and operational skills. You will work with a team of passionate engineers to drive the development and evolution of our hybrid cloud infrastructure management plane. You will play a key role in shaping the future of our product, ensuring product simplicity and delight for Nutanix customers.Engineering / R\&D at Nutanix
=============================


Nutanix Content Management Service (CMS) simplifies and unifies the management of business\-critical hybrid cloud infrastructure components by extending the management plane across network and geographic boundaries. We are developing a new backend service and architecture focused towards realizing our product vision of effectively scaling to hybrid cloud infrastructure demands. For administrators, CMS speeds time to value and reduces operational risk by introducing a no overhead, easy single pane of glass management model. For business owners, CMS increases cost efficiency and speed towards delivery of a resilient hybrid cloud infrastructure. CMS aspires to exemplify true hybrid cloud model through its product offering and integrate seamlessly with popular hyperscaler cloud platform offerings. CMS is expected to operate in large customer environments spanning hundreds of geographically distributed cluster environments with thousands of hybrid cloud infrastructure management entities. The CMS team’s primary technology stack is authored in Python and Golang. The team is responsible for core Nutanix services responsible for managing hybrid cloud entities.Your Role
=========

* **Team Leadership \& Development:** Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 6–8 engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous professional development.
* **Technical Direction \& Architecture:** Own the technical vision and system architecture for CMS and related product areas, driving scalable, performant, resilient, and reliable solutions.
* **Execution \& Lifecycle Delivery:** Oversee the complete product development lifecycle—from concept, system design, and project planning through implementation, performance engineering, testing, and release.
* **Product \& Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner closely with Product Management, Program Management, and other stakeholders to define aggressive yet achievable milestones, align engineering execution with market trends, and address Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs).
* **Engineering \& Operational Excellence:** Establish and enforce best practices in coding standards, automated testing, continuous integration, observability, and infrastructure monitoring to maximize developer productivity and deliver high\-quality products. Utilize AI coding tools and models to maintain high quality and velocity. Participate directly in technical deliverables through system design reviews, code reviews, and technical interviewing to maintain high standards for scale, security, and user experience.

What You Will Bring
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (required)
* 12\-14 years of software engineering experience.
* Proven experience with 2\+ years of managing small\-mid sized engineering teams.
* Proven ability to guide teams working in Go, python or similar systems programming languages.
* Solid hands\-on experience with cloud native platforms, distributed systems, containerization, and building enterprise grade APIs is required.
* Experience working in areas of enterprise product development or hyperscalers, including Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, VMware vSphere, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Ability to lead through influence, communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and drive alignment across engineering and other stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 The platform is a store execution and allocation\-review app used by store associates and managers on the floor of high\-SKU physical retail locations, often with unreliable connectivity. The product decisions here are inseparable from mobile Android realities — screen real estate, offline behavior, interrupted workflows, and non\-technical users under time pressure. This role owns the requirements, workflow design, and day\-to\-day product judgment for the mobile experience, and must be able to reason about Android constraints directly rather than translating through someone else.
   

  

**What This Role Entails**
**Requirements \& Product Definition**
* Own detailed functional requirements for the mobile app: user stories with clear given\-when\-then acceptance criteria, workflow diagrams, and edge cases — not just feature summaries.
* Translate ambiguous business asks (from clients or internal stakeholders) into structured requirements, calling out open design decisions explicitly rather than letting them stay implicit.
* Define the end\-to\-end store associate and store manager workflows: review, edit, approval, and escalation paths, including what happens when a device is offline or a sync conflict occurs.
* Maintain a live backlog of open product decisions (e.g., edit\-window rules, approval bounds, disposition of un\-actioned items) and drive them to resolution with the right stakeholders.


**Mobile \& Android Judgment**
* Understand and account for native Android constraints in every requirement: offline\-first data availability, screen size and interaction patterns for a floor associate (often one\-handed, gloved, or interrupted), and battery/network limitations on retail\-grade devices.
* Partner directly with the mobile engineering team on feasibility and sequencing — able to ask the right technical questions about sync behavior, conflict resolution, and performance rather than treating mobile as a generic 'frontend.'
* Review mobile prototypes and builds hands\-on (not just via specs) to catch usability issues specific to Android and to field conditions before they reach UAT.
* Flag when a requirement has architectural consequences (e.g., forces a specific offline\-sync behavior) and route it to engineering early rather than after the design is set.


**Delivery \& Client\-Facing Work**
* Support active client delivery: participate in requirement walkthroughs, UAT planning, and client Q\&A on product scope and behavior.
* Work backward from delivery milestones (e.g., data sign\-off, go\-live) to sequence requirements and flag scope risk early, with a recommendation attached — not just a flag.
* Produce client\-ready documentation (FRDs, workflow diagrams, release notes) in plain business language, distinct from internal engineering specs.
* Coordinate with QA on test scenarios for mobile\-specific risk areas: offline usage, interrupted sync, low\-connectivity environments, and device variability.


**Platform Thinking**
* Continuously separate what is client\-specific from what should be configurable at the platform level, and flag anything that risks being hard\-coded to a single client's workflow.
* Contribute to the reusable configuration framework (personas, hierarchy depth, edit windows, approval rules) so future clients can be configured in rather than custom\-built.


**What Lands You This Role**
**Must Have**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, with at least 4\+ years specifically on a native Android or Android\-first mobile product (not a web product with a mobile\-responsive view).
* Demonstrated ability to write detailed, unambiguous requirements — given\-when\-then acceptance criteria, explicit edge cases, and open\-decision tracking — not high\-level feature descriptions.
* Working knowledge of core Android product constraints: offline data behavior, sync/conflict scenarios, notification and background\-task limitations, and device fragmentation — enough to have a real conversation with a mobile architect, not just a glossary\-level familiarity.
* Experience shipping a product used by non\-technical, operationally focused end users in a physical, time\-pressured environment (retail floor, warehouse, field service, logistics) — the design tolerance for error and training is very different from a desk\-based B2B tool.
* Comfortable working directly from a live backlog of open design decisions and driving them to closure with multiple stakeholders, rather than waiting for decisions to be handed down.


**Good to Have**
* Prior experience in retail, logistics, or supply\-chain software (store operations, inventory, warehouse management, delivery/route planning) — familiarity with allocation, replenishment, or capacity\-constraint concepts is a plus.
* Experience working on a multi\-client or multi\-tenant B2B SaaS product, with prior practice distinguishing client\-specific asks from platform\-level configuration.
* Experience producing client\-facing documentation and presenting product decisions directly to client stakeholders.

 Own the Platform

* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.

jobs.description:
Job Description:
**Job Summary**  

As an Analyst – Environment Offer Data and Performance, you will collect, assess, analyze, and interpret environmental data related to products and solutions using recognized environmental assessment methodologies and frameworks such as LCA, PEP, and EPD.
You will support sustainable product development by identifying environmental improvement opportunities, ensuring environmental data accuracy and completeness in IT systems, and enabling compliance with environmental regulations and reporting standards.
The role contributes directly to the organization’s sustainability strategy, decarbonization objectives, circular economy initiatives, and environmentally responsible product innovation. You will collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to transform environmental data into actionable insights supporting sustainable decision\-making and regulatory compliance.
You will independently solve routine and moderately complex technical challenges related to sustainability data, environmental compliance, and product environmental performance while working under general guidance and established organizational standards. **Key Responsibilities*** Collect, validate, manage, and maintain environmental product data across internal systems and sustainability platforms.
* Conduct environmental assessments using methodologies and frameworks such as LCA, PEP, and EPD.
* Analyze environmental performance indicators and identify opportunities for sustainability improvement.
* Support product sustainability initiatives including decarbonization, eco\-design, material transparency, and circular economy programs.
* Ensure environmental data quality, completeness, traceability, and governance across enterprise systems.
* Support compliance with environmental regulations, customer requirements, and sustainability standards.
* Collaborate with Offer Management, R\&D, Sustainability, Procurement, Quality, and Digital teams.
* Develop sustainability reports, dashboards, metrics, and technical documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
* Support environmental declarations, sustainability disclosures, customer sustainability requests, and compliance documentation.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation initiatives, and digital sustainability transformation projects.

**Qualifications** **Education**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:* Environmental Engineering
* Environmental Science
* Sustainability
* Industrial Engineering
* Data Analytics

**Experience*** 5–10 years of experience in:
* Product sustainability
* Environmental compliance
* Environmental data analysis
* Sustainability reporting
* LCA/PEP/EPD development
* ESG and sustainability programs

**Technical Skills** **Sustainability Assessment Tools*** Proficiency in sustainability assessment tools such as SimaPro, GaBi, OpenLCA, Assets, and environmental data management platforms

**AI \& Digital Productivity Tools*** Experience with AI\-enabled and digital productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT, Power BI AI, tableau capabilities, and other generative AI solutions for analytics, reporting, automation, and productivity enhancement

**Sustainability \& Compliance Knowledge*** Knowledge of environmental sustainability methodologies, regulations, and compliance requirements including LCA, RoHS, REACH, Product Carbon Footprinting (PCF), California Proposition 65, Halogen\-Free requirements, SCIP, WEEE, and circular economy principles

**Data \& Analytics*** Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and data interpretation skills
* Experience with Excel, Power BI, reporting dashboards, and sustainability analytics
* Familiarity with ERP, PLM, and digital sustainability data systems is preferred

**Behavioral Competencies*** Strong analytical and technical problem\-solving capabilities
* Attention to detail and data accuracy
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Effective communication and stakeholder collaboration skills
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Passion for sustainability and environmental stewardship

jobs.description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**


If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Data Test Analyst**

**Purpose of the role**


The role resides within the Data Management Change Team, reporting to the Data Change Lead in Bangalore. The position is for a Data Business Analyst within the Data Analytics Office, focused on supporting operational business teams with requirements that depend on Asset Management Data Services. You will work across multiple data services and operational teams to support data service delivery aligned to stakeholder needs, with an initial focus on Security, Holdings and Environmental, Social and Governance data services and vendor data delivery to performance and reporting, client business, and investment teams.  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Elicit, interpret, and translate stakeholder conversations and written inputs into clear business requirements and functional requirements to support development and testing.
* Produce high\-quality business requirements and functional requirements documentation in line with project expectations and governance.
* Participate in, and where required chair, project and analysis meetings, clearly communicating outcomes, actions, and next steps.
* Define and support testing activities, including planning and executing data testing aligned to requirements and agreed test scenarios.
* Proactively explore brief requirements raised through Jira stories to achieve full clarity, identify gaps, and drive alignment across stakeholders.
* Manage defects for assigned deliveries, including tracking, prioritising, following up on fixes, and coordinating re\-testing with relevant teams.
* Communicate confidently and effectively, asking the right questions, challenging constructively when needed, and providing clear responses to stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with global and regional business and technology teams across time zones, contributing to delivery momentum and shared outcomes.

**To be successful you will:**

* Minimum 6 years’ relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in business analysis, including translating business needs into business requirements and functional requirements.
* Strong experience partnering with developers and testing teams to deliver outcomes aligned to documented requirements.
* In\-depth knowledge of holdings data, securities data, ESG data services, and ESG data providers.
* Experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Strong SQL skills (querying data, joining tables, using primary keys for analysis) and experience across Agile and Waterfall lifecycles, with hands\-on use of tools such as Quality Centre and Jira.

* Work with FSCM, Advanced Returns, LTMC, Migration Cockpit, Fiori Apps, and aATP.
* Support data migration activities and ensure data quality during SAP transformation initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve business processes through modern SAP capabilities.


Business Analysis \& Solution Delivery

* Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP solutions.
* Support SAP design, development, configuration, and implementation activities.
* Perform unit and integration testing.

* Perform basic debugging of SAP programs to identify and resolve application or configuration issues, including Smart Forms.
* Independently manage customer requests and complex business issues.
* Collaborate with cross\-module teams when issues involve multiple SAP processes or integrations.
* Mentor junior team members and share functional knowledge and best practices.


Global Collaboration

* Work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, end users, and global SAP teams.
* Support alternate shifts when required to provide coverage for U.S. time zones.
* Manage multiple customer requests, business priorities, and projects while maintaining quality and delivery timelines.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to global SAP enterprise solutions supporting a leading aerospace organization.
* Deepen your expertise in SAP S/4HANA, Order Management, Logistics Execution, aATP, GTS, FSCM, and Fiori.
* Work on complex cross\-functional SAP processes and integrations.
* Gain experience supporting global business stakeholders and U.S. time zones.
* Develop stronger capabilities in business analysis, solution design, troubleshooting, and process improvement.
* Learn how SAP technology supports complex aerospace business operations.
* Build leadership skills by mentoring junior team members and driving issue resolution independently.
* Gain exposure to SAP transformation, migration, and modernization initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM) or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
* 9\+ years of relevant SAP experience, or an advanced degree with 5\+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP Order Management and Logistics Execution.
* Strong understanding of SAP processes including:
	+ Order Management
	+ Deliveries
	+ Shipping
	+ Pricing
	+ Billing
	+ Returns
	+ ATP / Back Order Processing…

As a Product Analyst II at HackerRank, you will own the end\-to\-end analytics for our products and platforms, working across AI\-powered experiences, developer\-facing products, content, community growth, or platform initiatives. This is not a BI reporting role — you will own and drive analytics initiatives end\-to\-end and act as a thought partner to Product, Engineering, Content, Design, and business stakeholders, helping answer not only "what happened?" but also "what should we build, improve, prioritize, or measure next?"

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

****About Caterpillar****
 Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off\-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel\-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed to and contributing to a reduced\-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

****Job Summary****
 We are seeking a skilled
 **Business Process Analyst** 
**to** 
**join Global Business Technology \- Caterpillar Financial Services India Private Limited**
 The preference for this role is to be based out of
 **Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
****What You Will Do****
**Job Duties:**
**Evolving Regulatory and Compliance Landscape**
* India continues to experience frequent regulatory and compliance changes that require close collaboration between business, legal, compliance, and IT stakeholders. Recent initiatives have demonstrated the need for strong local knowledge and dedicated coordination to assess impacts, clarify requirements, and ensure timely and compliant implementation.


**Business Partnership and Stakeholder Engagement**
* The RBA serves as a trusted partner to the business, supporting not only operational issues resolution, but also strategic initiatives and governance activities. The role actively participates in MD Governance forums and local IT committee meetings, providing business systems expertise and insights.


**Country\-Specific Expertise and Operational Continuity**
* India's operating model includes unique business practices, regulatory requirements, and system processes that require specialized knowledge. Maintaining dedicated in\-country expertise helps preserve institutional knowledge, reduce delivery and operational risks, and ensure consistent support for both daily operations and future initiatives.

 Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

* Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.


**Problem Solving:** 
 Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

* Uses fact\-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
   

  

**Job Description:**
* 10\+ years of hands\-on Business Analyst experience.
* Strong in\-depth knowledge of different Corporate Actions.
* Experience in leading design and implementation of custom and product strategy based technical projects.
* Strong client connect and should be able to drive the whole Implementation cycle.
* Should have a good SQL knowledge to carry out the daily work.
* Have good understanding of the North American/European Capital Markets, Fixed Income \& Equity Brokerage Operations.
* Be able to evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, uncover areas for improvement, develop and implement solutions and ensure that the solutions meet business needs and requirements.
* Lead ongoing reviews of business processes and developing optimization strategies
* Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrated with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.
* Collaboratively work with all stakeholders – Management, Product, Development, QA and BAU teams.


 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
   

  

**Use of AI in Hiring**
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
